ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited for the following temporary posts under DST project “Technology Enabling Centre
(TEC). The posts will be initially filled up for one year but can be further extended depending on the
performance and work capabilities of the selected candidates.
Job Profile
1. Delivering letters, collecting bills or getting signatures on various documents from other places.
2. Serving refreshments to visitors
3. Manage social media of TEC
4. Assist staff of TEC in their activities
5. Providing logistics in events of TEC
Other Requirements
 Fully flexible and able to work during evening and weekend (if the need arises)
Working Days: Monday to Saturday
Recruitment Process
Application along with the following documents (in the order given below) in a single envelope should reach at
“TEC/CIIPP, Ist floor Guru Tegh Bahadur Bhawan, Opposite University School of Open Learning Panjab
University Sector 14, Chandigarh – 160014” by speed post / registered post before 5 PM of 15 February, 2023.
Envelope should be titled “Application for the post of Assistant”. Any application reached after 15 February,
2023 will not be entertained.
1. Application Form given in Annexure I; filled by hand with blue colour (not by typing) and ink-sign in the
places specified. Do not insert a scanned signature.
2. CV
3. Personal statement (maximum 500 words) on why you think you are suitable for the position
4. Attested copies of certificates of (i) Class X (ii) Class XII / Diploma (iv) Experience certificates
supporting details mentioned in the application form/CV/personal statement (v) Government issued
Photo ID proof (Aadhaar card/ passport/ DL) (vi) Date of Birth Proof (vii) Any other document
supporting your application
5. Written and signed explanation for any missing documents
Candidates found to be potentially suitable will be informed via email to appear in next step of selection process
(written test / personal interview / practical test). Those appearing for the interview should come with original of
the application file and all documents submitted by email; and also one attested photocopy of the same.
